{{Quote|One moment we're safely orbiting this planet... the next, all systems go dead and we crash-glide into seemingly endless ocean...!|C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref>}}
'''Drexel''' was the lone [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Drexel system/Legends|Drexel system]].<ref name="SW15SD" /> It was a [[Water/Legends|water]] world, home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sea-dragon]]s.

==History==
===Old Republic era===
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] exiled the corrupt Governor [[Quarg]] to Drexel, along with his fellow [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. There, the pirates and their descendants created a unique civilization, centered around a sailing ship that was a mobile [[City/Legends|city]]. Quarg was succeeded by his equally corrupt son, the younger Governor Quarg. Some of the inhabitants of the city-ship revolted against Quarg's tyranny. The rebels created a new civilization. They used technology to communicate with native Sea-dragons, with whom they formed a symbiotic lifestyle, and thus became known as [[Dragon Lords]]. The Sea-dragons willingly allowed the rebels to ride them and took the rebels to dwell in underwater caves. The Dragon Lords waged constant war on Quarg. The baby Sea-dragons infested the city-ship, acting as [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. The crew of the city-ship ignored the babies, thinking them mere lizards, not realizing they were young Sea-dragons.

===Imperial era===
Many years later, the Dragon Lords finally defeated [[Quarg]]'s son with the help of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], during the [[Battle of Drexel]]. Han Solo defeated the pirate [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Drexel.
